verdict.rationale: Relay is documented as a business banking platform where small businesses open and manage their own accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows an embedded banking or BaaS offering that lets developers provision accounts for their own customers under Relay's licensing. Because a fintech banking platform could plausibly ship such a capability, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer embedded banking accounts to my customers without holding my own financial license
